build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the scene using C.add with scale and center position
add_static_bars: add static bar objects to the scene with configurable scale angle and position constraints
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by setting body1 body2 and their spatial relationship to TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata solution tier to TWO_BALLS using C.set_meta
